faqs.q: Can I book a test drive?
faqs.a: Yes, test drives are available Monday to Saturday. You can book by phone or ask me to note your preferred date and model.
Yes, we offer BMW Financial Services with 0% APR on selected models through June 2025, and flexible monthly payment plans.

faqs.q: Do you buy or accept trade-ins?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer trade-in valuations on any make or model. Bring your vehicle any weekday and we will provide a same-day estimate.
Yes, we stock the BMW iX3 and the MINI Countryman SE hybrid. The iX3 is currently on order but we can reserve one for you.

faqs.q: Do you have a service centre?
faqs.a: Yes, our authorised BMW service centre is open Monday to Friday 8:00–18:00. You can book a service appointment by phone or online.

faqs.q: Where are you located and how do I get there?
faqs.a: We are at Calle de Serrano 45, Madrid. Closest metro is Serrano on Line 4. Parking is available in the adjacent Interparking.
